post_body:
Fall Only Housing

Does any body know of any places by main, that offer fall only housing. I plan on finishing fall next year.
Im sure that there are exceptions, but landlords in State College exclusively do year-long leases starting in August because they know that demand for housing is super low in the summer so the only way to guarantee year-long income is to lock people into year-long leases.
Your best bet is probably to sign a lease and then sublet in the spring. Ive never heard of an August-January lease around these parts.
Its also possible that you could live on campus? Ive never done that so I dont know how it works.
Unless someone is subletting in the fall which isnt as popular as in the spring (and you dont want a full year apartment) best bet may be to do on-campus housing for just the fall semester. I know of people who have done one semester housing.
Im p sure u can do a fall only contract w housing. Like the dorms
Look into GN Associates because I remember they did fall only housing whenever the spring came around
The view, lions gate, and nittany gardens does something called corporate housing so that also could be fall semester only
Craigslist
